title: Raj Kapoor's birth chart
metaDescription: Raj Kapoor's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 22.0° Sagittarius. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: 0.5° separates the Sun and Neptune from an exact trine; at that range identity and imagination read as one mechanism. A trine runs downhill — the talent that never announces itself because it never had to.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 22.0° Sagittarius — deep enough in the third decan (20°–30°) that the Sun, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 11.9° Capricorn, Venus at 20.6° Scorpio, Mars at 26.9° Pisces. Mercury in an earth sign reads as thought with its feet on the ground; Venus in a water sign reads as attraction that works by atmosphere; Mars in a water sign reads as effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The Sun to Neptune is the closest call of the day, a trine within 0.5°. Trines are read as inheritance rather than achievement: the ease is genuine, and nothing about it was earned. Behind it, Mercury opposition Pluto at 1.0°, and Mercury sextile Saturn at 1.4° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Every angle named here holds for the whole of that day at the birthplace, so an unknown hour cannot take it away.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, two placements stand out. Venus in Scorpio at 20.6° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Jupiter in Sagittarius at 29.1° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 5 water, 3 fire, 1 earth by element and 4 mutable, 3 fixed, 2 cardinal by mode. No settled placement falls in air — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Cancer into Leo during that day at the birthplace, travelling 11.8° between one midnight and the next. Half the day belongs to each sign, and the split falls at an unrecorded hour — so this page holds the Moon as a genuine unknown.
